request.business_problem: Release notes are written from raw commit lists by whoever has time, so they are technical, late and inconsistent.
request.tasks: Convert a changelog or commit list into customer-facing release notes grouped as New, Improved and Fixed, in plain language, flagging breaking changes and anything that needs a customer action.
request.required_output: Markdown release notes with a short headline summary and a 'Needs your attention' section when relevant.
request.examples:
feat(export): add CSV export to reports
fix(auth): token refresh loop on Safari
BREAKING: remove v1 /orders endpoint

smoke.prompt: Write release notes from: 'feat: dark mode for dashboard; fix: invoice PDF missing logo; BREAKING: drop support for API key auth, use OAuth'
